title: RECOMP SETTINGS
subtitle: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja 5
footer: UP/DOWN Select   LEFT/RIGHT Change   R1/L1 Section   X Apply   A Close
note: As configuracoes so sao salvas ao apertar X (Apply). Alteracoes pendentes aparecem como NAO SALVO.

source.captured_from: Free Battle -> Practice -> Character/Sakura -> Linked Mode Auto -> stage -> VS screen -> Square

layout.font: texture-based in the original; the new recomp menu can use a bitmap font

items.label: Resolution
items.description: Window and presentation target; the internal GS raster scale follows automatically when you press X (1080p = 4x/2048x1792). The window can still be maximized.

items.label: Screen Mode
items.description: Windowed, exclusive fullscreen or borderless desktop fullscreen.

items.label: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Presentation aspect ratio (PS2_PRESENT_AR). The widescreen FOV follows on the next frame when patches are loaded.

items.label: FPS
items.description: Internal FPS target: 30, 60 or 120. With V-Sync On it is capped to the monitor; with V-Sync Off it can exceed it.

items.label: Anti-Aliasing
items.description: Post-process anti-aliasing. FXAA is 4 taps; HQ adds diagonals; Ultra adds a wider 12-tap kernel (more GPU work).

items.label: Graphic API
items.description: WebGPU backend. Auto picks the best available; Vulkan is available on Linux/Windows; DirectX 12 appears only on Windows. Applied on the next start.

items.label: Texture Filtering
items.description: Auto follows the game TEX1 bilinear flag; Nearest/Bilinear force the texture filter.

items.label: Anisotropic Filtering
items.description: Reserved: the PS2 GS has no anisotropic filter. The value is saved for future renderers.

items.label: Draw Distance
items.description: Reserved for a future game patch: this game streams the scenario and exposes no draw-distance variable, so this value is saved but has no visual effect.

items.label: MTVU
items.description: Multithreaded VU1: run VU1 microcode on its own host thread. Applied on the next start.

items.label: HUD Aspect Ratio
items.description: HUD X correction aspect. Auto follows the presentation aspect; Off disables the correction (recommended for Master Mode scenery).

items.label: HUD Scale
items.description: Manual HUD X factor. Auto lets HUD Aspect Ratio decide; applies on new HUD draws.

items.label: V-Sync
items.description: Presentation V-Sync (Fifo). Off uses Mailbox/Immediate when available.

items.label: Exit Game
items.description: Select this row and press X (Apply) to close the game.

items.label: Save State
items.description: Write a state file to states/naruto.ps2 at the next emulation frame. Includes the GS VRAM and all machine registers.

items.label: Load State
items.description: Restore states/naruto.ps2. The window/aspect settings stay as they are; the game resumes from the saved frame.

items.label: Inverted Camera
items.description: Invert both right-stick axes (X and Y) used by the camera.
